newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Cartel Office rejects Herlitz bid.
newsitem.headline: German Cartel Office rejects Herlitz bid.

text.p: The Federal Cartel Office said on Monday it had office supply maker Herlitz AG's takeover of Gronau-based paper products manufacturer Landre GmbH.
The Cartel Office said in a statement that both companies were leading manufacturers of educational materials even before Herlitz took control of Landre through a trustee in 1993.
Together, the combined Herlitz group had 1995 sales of 1.8 billion marks ($1.1 billion), of which around 880 million marks were generated from the sale of stationery and office supplies.
The Cartel Office had previously warned Herlitz that it believed the takeover presented anti-trust problems.
Herlitz bought Landre in June 1996, but the Berlin-based competition watchdog has said that Herlitz has had financial and managerial control of Landre since 1993.
